links.outcome: Extent of ongoing monitoring of deployed radiology AI
links.effect: Monitoring was nascent; most AI projects had not reached full live deployment. Manual retrospective comparison with the radiology report was most common; automated and statistical methods were much less common.
links.quote: The findings suggest that AI monitoring in radiology is still relatively nascent as most of the AI projects had not yet progressed into a fully live clinical deployment.

links.outcome: Challenges radiologists face in monitoring AI, including resource capacity
links.effect: Lack of resources to support AI monitoring and uncertainty about building a robust, scalable monitoring process were the biggest challenges.
links.quote: The biggest challenges are a lack of resources to support AI monitoring and uncertainty about how to create a robust and scalable process of monitoring the breadth and variety of radiology AI applications available.

unlisted_practices: Using an ensemble of mixed monitoring methods across multiple domains and metrics for radiology AI

screen.reason: Qualitative interview study of radiologists assessing current post-deployment monitoring practices and challenges for clinical imaging AI; it observes and describes practices rather than testing their comparative effects.
